stem.text: A tennis ball is released from rest at the top of a tall building.
Which graph best represents the variation with time $t$ of the acceleration $a$ of the ball as it falls, assuming that the effect of air resistance is **not** negligible?

A.alt: Acceleration against time graph: a starts at a maximum at t = 0 and decreases steadily towards zero

B.alt: Acceleration against time graph: a starts at a maximum at t = 0, decreases, then levels off at a constant positive value

C.alt: Acceleration against time graph: a starts at zero and increases, levelling off at a constant positive value

D.alt: Acceleration against time graph: a horizontal line at a constant positive value for all t
